items.prompt:
The main energy source for Earth's climate is
A) the Sun
B) the Moon
C) wind
D) volcanoes

If energy in equals energy out, the climate
A) stays steady
B) always warms
C) always cools
D) disappears

Earth gives off energy
A) back to space
B) into the ground only
C) nowhere
D) only at night

If gases trap more outgoing energy, the climate
A) warms
B) cools
C) stays the same
D) freezes instantly

If Earth received less solar energy over time, the climate would tend to
A) cool
B) warm
C) stay the same forever
D) vanish

Climate stays steady when energy in and out are
A) balanced
B) unbalanced
C) zero
D) random

Trapping more outgoing energy warms the climate because
A) less energy escapes, so more heat stays on Earth
B) more energy escapes
C) the Sun turns off
D) energy is destroyed
items.answer: A) less energy escapes, so more heat stays on Earth

items.prompt:
Which best models how climate changes?
A) Energy comes in from the Sun and out to space; changing the balance changes the climate
B) Climate never changes
C) Only wind sets the climate
D) The Moon controls climate
items.answer: A) Energy comes in from the Sun and out to space; changing the balance changes the climate
